resources.string: Shows writing suggestions over your current app after a typing pause. Reads only the focused editable field and replaces it only when you tap Use. Password fields, protected apps and the lock screen are skipped. Format stays on your device. Only your chosen default service runs automatically: Translate sends the draft to your selected provider; Izohchi sends a word or phrase to Izoh.uz. No typing history is saved. You can pause suggestions in Sayqalchi or its Quick Settings tile.
